segments.en: Near the end of the month, Alex handles a more professional task. As the project becomes more professional, Alex gives a clear update and checks the risks. Alex checks "training data" and "model training" before making a decision and explains the possible risk. In the discussion, Alex uses "I read that ..." and "According to the report ..." to clarify the goal, timing, and next step. Finally, Alex documents "link to documentation" and "cite a source" so another teammate can review the work later. The work is not perfect, but the update is clear, careful, and useful.

segments.en: Near the end of the month, Alex handles a more professional task. As the project becomes more professional, Alex gives a clear update and checks the risks. Alex checks "confidence level" and "verify the answer" before making a decision and explains the possible risk. In the discussion, Alex uses "I see it differently." and "We need more information." to clarify the goal, timing, and next step. Finally, Alex documents "permanent link" and "documentation page" so another teammate can review the work later. The work is not perfect, but the update is clear, careful, and useful.
